name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front of you.
Tuck your hips under so your lower back flattens.
Push your hips forward until you feel the front of the back thigh stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold, then swap sides.

name: Butterfly Stretch
steps: Sit on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together.
Pull your heels in towards your body.
Hold your feet with both hands and sit up tall.
Let your knees fall out towards the floor.
Lean forward gently and hold the stretch.

name: Stair Climber
steps: Step onto the stair machine and start it at a slow speed.
Stand upright and rest your hands lightly on the rails.
Take full steps instead of short, bouncy ones.
Push through your heel on every step to use the glutes.
Drop the speed before you step off.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
arName: رفع السمانة بسكوات جالس على جهاز ليج برس
steps: Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the footplate.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the footplate, shoulder-width apart.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the footplate, keeping your heels off the edge.
Release the safety handles and push the footplate away from you by extending your knees.
Once your knees are fully extended, slowly lower your heels by flexing your calves.

name: Weighted Donkey Calf Raise
steps: Stand on a raised platform with your toes on the edge and your heels hanging off.
Hold onto a stable object for support.
Raise your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lever Standing Calf Raise
steps: Adjust the machine to your height and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your shoulders under the pads and hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bodyweight Standing Calf Raise
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on a wall or stable surface for balance.
Slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Standing Rocking Leg Calf Raise
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell across your upper back.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, balancing on the balls of your feet.
Slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Step-down
arName: نزول من الصندوق مع تثبيت بساق واحدة
steps: Stand on a low box or step on one leg.
Let the other leg hang just off the edge.
Bend your standing knee slowly to lower the free heel towards the floor.
Tap the floor lightly without shifting your weight onto it.
Straighten your standing leg to rise back up and switch legs after the set.

name: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise
arName: رفع السمانة جالساً بساق واحدة بالدمبل - قبضة هامر
steps: Sit on a bench with the ball of one foot on a low step and your heel hanging off.
Rest a dumbbell on top of that knee and hold it in place.
Push through the ball of your foot to raise your heel as high as you can.
Pause at the top and squeeze your calf.
Lower your heel slowly below the step and switch legs after the set.

name: Smith Calf Raise
arName: رفع السمانة المعكوس على جهاز سميث
steps: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and step under it.
Rest the bar across your upper back and stand with the balls of your feet on a low step.
Unlock the bar and let your heels hang off the edge.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly below the step.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
steps: Stand with your toes on an elevated surface, such as a step or block.
Place your hands on a stable support, such as a wall or railing, for balance.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise
arName: رفع السمانة بالدمبل على ساق واحدة
steps: Stand on the edge of a step or platform with your heels hanging off and your toes on the step.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place your other hand on a wall or railing for support.
Raise your heel as high as possible, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down below the step.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.

name: One Leg Floor Calf Raise
arName: رفع السمانة من الأرض بساق واحدة
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on a wall or sturdy object for balance.
Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body up onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
steps: Stand facing a wall and put both hands on it.
Step one foot back and keep that leg straight.
Press the back heel into the floor.
Lean towards the wall until you feel the calf stretch.
Hold, then swap legs.

name: Jump Rope
steps: Hold a handle in each hand with the rope behind your heels.
Keep your elbows close to your ribs and your chest up.
Turn the rope with your wrists, not your whole arms.
Hop just high enough to clear the rope, landing on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm and stay light on your feet.

name: Band Calf Raise
steps: Stand with the balls of your feet on the middle of a band.
Hold the ends of the band up at your shoulders.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.

name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the barbell towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your forearms resting on your thighs, holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Allow the barbell to roll down to your fingertips, keeping your wrists straight.
Slowly curl the barbell up towards your forearms by flexing your wrists.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Shrug
steps: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the cable handles with an overhand grip and let your arms hang down in front of you.
Keeping your arms straight, shrug your shoulders up towards your ears.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Scapula Dips
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows and retracting your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to squeeze a pencil between them.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to extend your elbows and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Scapular Pull-up
steps: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Retract your shoulder blades by pulling them down and back.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, focusing on squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Smith Shrug
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulders up towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Lying Leg Curl
arName: تمرين الفخذ الخلفي من الاستلقاء بالدمبل
steps: Lie face down on a flat bench with your knees just off the end.
Have a partner place a dumbbell between your feet and squeeze it tight.
Curl your heels towards your glutes, lifting the dumbbell.
Keep your hips pressed into the bench at the top.
Lower the dumbbell slowly until your legs are almost straight.

name: Towel Hamstring Stretch
steps: Lie on your back and loop a towel around the sole of one foot.
Hold an end of the towel in each hand.
Straighten that leg and pull it up towards the ceiling.
Stop when you feel a stretch along the back of the thigh and hold.
Lower the leg slowly and switch sides.

name: Lying Leg Curl
arName: ليج كيرل على ساق واحدة واقفاً
steps: Lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad just above your heels.
Line your knees up with the machine's pivot and hold the handles.
Curl your heels towards your glutes as far as you can.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the top without lifting your hips.
Lower the pad slowly until your legs are almost straight.

name: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Sit in the machine with the pad resting on your lower shins.
Lock the thigh pad down so your legs cannot lift.
Hold the handles and keep your back against the seat.
Curl your heels down and back as far as they go.
Let your legs straighten slowly against the resistance.

name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart holding a kettlebell in both hands.
Keep a small bend in your knees and your back flat.
Push your hips back and let the kettlebell slide down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Keep a soft bend in the standing knee.
Hinge forward and let the free leg rise behind you.
Lower until your torso and back leg are almost level with the floor.
Squeeze the glute to come back upright without touching down.

name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
steps: Wedge one end of a barbell into a landmine holder and load the other end.
Stand facing the bar and hold the loaded end with both hands.
Keep your back flat and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and let the bar travel down your thighs.
Drive your hips forward to stand up and squeeze your glutes.

name: Lying Hamstring Walkout
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and lift your hips into a bridge.
Keep your hips up for the whole exercise.
Walk your heels out step by step until your legs are almost straight.
Walk them back in the same way.
Stop if your hips start to drop towards the floor.

name: Stability Ball Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on top of a stability ball.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Pull the ball towards your glutes by bending your knees.
Keep your hips high while the ball rolls in.
Push the ball back out slowly until your legs are straight.

name: Hamstring Stretch
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other tucked in.
Keep your back long instead of rounding it.
Hinge forward over the straight leg.
Reach towards your foot until you feel the hamstring pull.
Hold the stretch, then change legs.

name: Seated Forward Fold
steps: Sit on the floor with both legs straight in front of you.
Sit up tall on your sit bones.
Hinge from your hips and reach towards your feet.
Let your head and neck relax as you fold.
Hold and breathe into the stretch.

name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips, kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips, grab the handle with both hands and hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward hard so the bell swings up to chest height on its own.
Keep your arms relaxed and your back flat the whole way.
Let the bell fall back between your legs and load the next rep.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
steps: Hold the kettlebell by the horns against your chest, elbows tucked in.
Set your feet shoulder-width apart with your toes turned out slightly.
Sit down between your heels, keeping your chest tall and the bell close.
Go as deep as your hips allow without your lower back rounding.
Drive through the floor to stand back up.

name: Kettlebell Front Squat
steps: Clean one kettlebell to the rack position, resting on your forearm and chest.
Keep the wrist straight and the elbow pointing down.
Squat down with your torso upright and the bell locked in place.
Push back up without letting the bell drift forward.
Do all your reps on one side, then swap.

name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand over the kettlebell with a wide stance and your toes turned out.
Hinge down and grab the handle with both hands, arms straight.
Brace your core, then stand up by squeezing your glutes.
Keep the bell travelling in a straight line close to your body.
Lower it back to the floor under control.

name: Kettlebell Single-Leg Deadlift
steps: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg.
Hinge forward, letting the free leg extend straight behind you.
Keep your hips level and your back flat as the bell lowers.
Stop when you feel the hamstring of the standing leg load up.
Squeeze the glute to come back upright.

name: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold the kettlebell against your chest in the goblet position.
Step one foot back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Row
steps: Hinge forward with one hand braced on a bench or your thigh.
Let the kettlebell hang at full stretch from the other hand.
Pull the bell to your hip, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze the shoulder blade at the top without twisting your torso.
Lower it slowly and repeat, then swap sides.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Press
steps: Start with the kettlebell racked at shoulder height, wrist straight.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your ribs stay down.
Press the bell straight overhead until your elbow locks out.
Finish with the bell sitting behind your wrist, not in front.
Lower it back to the rack position under control.

name: Kettlebell Push Press
steps: Rack the kettlebell at shoulder height with your feet under your hips.
Dip slightly at the knees, keeping your torso vertical.
Drive up with your legs and let that push the bell overhead.
Lock the elbow out at the top with the bell over your shoulder.
Bring it back to the rack and reset before the next rep.

name: Kettlebell High Pull
steps: Set up as if for a swing, kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge and hike the bell back, then snap your hips forward.
As the bell rises, pull your elbow high and back.
The bell should end up in front of your shoulder, not overhead.
Guide it back down into the next hinge.

name: Kettlebell Shrug
steps: Stand tall holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and your chin tucked.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears.
Pause at the top without rolling the shoulders.
Lower them slowly all the way down.

name: Kettlebell Farmer Carry
steps: Pick up a heavy kettlebell in each hand and stand tall.
Pull your shoulders back and brace your core.
Walk in a straight line with short, controlled steps.
Do not let your torso lean or the bells swing.
Set them down when your grip starts to give out.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Hold one kettlebell by the horns with both hands overhead.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and close to your head.
Bend at the elbows to lower the bell behind your head.
Stop when you feel the stretch in your triceps.
Straighten your arms to press it back up.

name: Kettlebell Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and heels lightly down.
Hold the kettlebell by the horns in front of your chest.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Rotate your torso to take the bell beside one hip, then the other.
Move from the ribs, not just the arms.

name: Kettlebell Side Bend
steps: Stand tall with a kettlebell hanging in one hand.
Put your free hand behind your head and keep your hips square.
Bend sideways towards the loaded side, letting the bell slide down your leg.
Come back up by pulling with the opposite side of your waist.
Finish the set, then swap hands.

name: Ring Dip
steps: Set the rings at hip height and grip them with your palms facing in.
Jump into support with your arms locked and the rings turned out.
Lower your chest between the rings, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Push back up to lockout and turn the rings out again at the top.
Keep your shoulders down and your body still through every rep.

name: Ring Push-Up
steps: Hang the rings a few centimetres off the floor and take a plank on them.
Squeeze your glutes and abs so your body holds one straight line.
Lower your chest to ring height, letting the rings drift out slightly.
Press back up and pull the rings back under your shoulders.
The higher the rings, the easier it gets, so set them to suit you.

name: Ring Chest Fly
steps: Set the rings at chest height and lean forward with arms out in front.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows and your body in one line.
Open your arms out to the sides, letting your chest stretch under control.
Pull the rings back together by squeezing your chest, not by bending your arms.
Walk your feet back to make it harder, forward to make it easier.

name: Ring Triceps Extension
steps: Set the rings at waist height and lean forward with straight arms.
Keep your body in one line from head to heels.
Bend only at the elbows, letting your hands travel over your head.
Stop when your forearms reach the rings, then press back to straight arms.
Keep your elbows pointing forward the whole way.

name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
steps: Place a flat bench with one end facing a low pulley.
Attach a short straight bar and lie on the bench with your head towards the stack.
Hold the bar with a narrow overhand grip and your arms straight up.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten your arms again without moving your elbows.

name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
steps: Set a pulley at the top and attach a single handle.
Face the stack and hold the handle with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbow pinned to your side and your knees soft.
Push the handle down until your arm is straight.
Let it rise slowly and switch arms after the set.

name: Barbell Incline Triceps Extension
arName: تمدد الترايسبس المائل على جهاز السميث
steps: Lie back on an incline bench holding a barbell with a close grip.
Press the bar up until it sits above your head with straight arms.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Extend your arms to bring the bar back up.

name: Dumbbell Lying Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise the dumbbells straight over your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms still for the whole set.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Straighten your arms to bring the dumbbells back up.

name: Reverse-Grip Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and face the stack.
Hold the bar with your palms facing up.
Pin your elbows to your sides.
Push the bar down towards your thighs until your arms are straight.
Let the bar rise slowly without moving your elbows.

name: Barbell Seated Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Sit on a bench with back support and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a barbell or EZ bar with a close grip.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar behind your head by bending only your elbows.
Extend your arms to bring the bar back overhead.

name: Dumbbell Tate Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the dumbbells over your chest with your palms facing your feet.
Bend your elbows out to the sides to lower the dumbbells to your chest.
Keep your upper arms still as the dumbbells touch.
Straighten your arms to press the dumbbells back up.

name: V-Bar Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a V-bar to a high pulley and face the stack.
Hold the bar with your palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and your elbows at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let the bar rise slowly to chest height.

name: Ring Pull-Up
steps: Hang from the rings with your arms straight and palms facing forward.
Set your shoulders down and away from your ears.
Pull your chest towards the rings, turning your palms in as you rise.
Finish with the rings by your chest and your elbows tight to your sides.
Lower under control until your arms are straight again.

name: Ring Chin-Up
steps: Hang from the rings with your palms turned towards you.
Keep your ribs down and your legs still.
Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down to your sides.
Get your chin over the rings without swinging.
Lower slowly all the way to straight arms.

name: Ring Inverted Row
steps: Set the rings at hip height and hang underneath with straight arms.
Walk your feet out until your body is one straight line.
Pull the rings to your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Touch the rings to your sides, pause, and lower under control.
The flatter your body, the harder the row.

name: Ring Face Pull
steps: Hold the rings at head height and lean back with straight arms.
Keep your body in one line from shoulders to heels.
Pull the rings apart and towards your forehead, elbows high.
Squeeze your rear shoulders for a second at the end.
Lower slowly and keep your neck relaxed.

name: Ring Biceps Curl
steps: Hold the rings with palms up and lean back with straight arms.
Lock your body in one line and keep your elbows high and still.
Curl yourself up by bending only at the elbows.
Bring your hands beside your head, then lower under control.
Step your feet forward to make it harder.

name: Cable Preacher Curl
steps: Place a preacher bench in front of a low pulley with a short bar.
Rest your upper arms on the pad and hold the bar with your palms up.
Start with your arms fully straight.
Curl the bar up towards your head.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight again.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up and across towards the opposite shoulder.
Keep your palm facing in without twisting the wrist.
Lower it slowly and repeat with the other arm.

name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
steps: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet flat and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up, turning your palms to face up.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to your sides.

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
steps: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold the handle with your palm facing up and your arm straight.
Keep your elbow still at your side.
Curl the handle up towards your chest.
Lower it slowly and switch arms after the set.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
steps: Set the preacher bench so your armpits rest on top of the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing up.
Rest your upper arms on the pad with your arms straight.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight again.

name: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees soft.
Hold the barbell with your palms up and your hands wider than your shoulders.
Let the bar rest against your thighs with your arms straight.
Curl the bar up towards your chest without swinging.
Lower the bar slowly back to your thighs.

name: Zottman Curl
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up with your palms facing up.
At the top, turn your wrists so your palms face down.
Lower the dumbbells slowly with your palms still facing down.
Turn your palms back up at the bottom before the next rep.

name: Machine Biceps Curl
steps: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine's pivot.
Rest the backs of your arms on the pad and grab the handles.
Keep your upper arms pressed into the pad.
Curl the handles up until your arms are fully bent.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and your palms facing down.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders with your palms still down.
Pause at the top without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to your thighs.

name: Band Biceps Curl
steps: Stand on the middle of a band and hold one end in each hand.
Keep your feet shoulder-width apart and your palms facing forward.
Curl one hand up towards your shoulder while the other stays down.
Lower it and curl the other hand in turn.
Keep your elbows still and speed up once the motion feels easy.

name: Ring Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back with your heels in the rings, set just off the floor.
Lift your hips so your body makes one line from shoulders to heels.
Pull your heels towards your backside by bending your knees.
Keep your hips high the whole way, then straighten your legs slowly.
Drop your hips to the floor to rest between sets.

name: Ring Ab Rollout
steps: Hold the rings at hip height with straight arms and lean in.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes so your back stays flat.
Let your arms travel out overhead as your body lowers forward.
Go only as far as you can hold without your hips sagging.
Pull the rings back down to your hips to return.
